mapper.sql: select h.hotel_id,h.activity_id,h.hotel_name,h.phone,h.address,h.cover_url,h.sale_status,h.sort_order, h.del_flag,h.create_by,h.create_time,h.update_by,h.update_time,h.remark, (select count(1) from yc_hotel_room r where r.hotel_id=h.hotel_id and r.del_flag='0') as room_count, (select count(1) from yc_hotel_order o where o.hotel_id=h.hotel_id and o.del_flag='0') as order_count from yc_hotel h
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when sale_status='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as openCount from yc_hotel where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_hotel set del_flag='2' where hotel_id in #{id}
